SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM lineitem

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_price
FROM lineitem

SELECT AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount
FROM lineitem

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_price
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_discount > 0.08

SELECT l_returnflag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM lineitem
GROUP BY l_returnflag

SELECT l_returnflag, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_price
FROM lineitem
GROUP BY l_returnflag

SELECT l_returnflag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_discount > 0.05
GROUP BY l_returnflag

SELECT l_suppkey, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM lineitem
GROUP BY l_suppkey

SELECT
    c.c_mktsegment,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o
    ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment

SELECT
    c.c_mktsegment,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_price
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o
    ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
